network_cmds_sample: mkdir -p /tmp/disc-src && cd /tmp/disc-src && curl -sL 'https://stratoplan-school.com/disc/' -o page.html && wc -c page.html && head -c 2000 page.html
cd /tmp/disc-src && curl -sL 'https://stratoplan-school.com/disc/result/' -o result.html && wc -c result.html && grep -n 'script\\|token' result.html | head -30

cd /tmp/disc-src && curl -s -A 'Mozilla/5.0' -o disc_live.js 'https://stratoplan-school.com/disc/js/disc.js' && wc -c disc_live.js && curl -s -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://stratoplan-school.com/disc/' -o page_live.html && diff -q page_live.html page.html && echo PAGE-SAME
